_comment: Template for the conductor ARM of the A/B bench, rendered by run.sh into work/.
Applied per-run via `claude --settings <rendered>` ON TOP of the live config, so both
arms share the machine's real authentication - the credential-copy revocation problem
that killed the v1 instrument cannot occur.
The hook set mirrors what tools/settings-json.py installs for real. CONDUCTOR_LESSONS
points every lessons consumer at a nonexistent file: the bench must not inject this
machine's live lessons (a confound) and must not trip DISTILL DUE mid-scenario.
